Impacted Systems: Applications using POLY1305 Message Authentication Code (MAC) on the Windows 64-bit platform
Applications using OpenSSL subsystems such as OCSP, PKCS7/SMIME, CMS, CMP/CRMF, or TS
Systems using X.509 certificate chains containing policy constraints
Systems processing X.400 addresses within an X.509 GeneralName
Attack Vector: Disruption of the internal state of applications
Inducing exponential consumption of computational resources
Providing arbitrary pointers to a memcmp call
